title: Resource contracts
description: ResourceSpec (21 §4 Resource; 00 §4 amendment, §4.2 Regeneration, §4.3 Resources), owned by resource@1.

ResourceInt.description: A resource bound, value or amount: a 32-bit signed integer, so that every derived value (regeneration, costs, adjustments) stays exact in every kernel's arithmetic.

ResourceSpec.description: A typed bounded integer resource each body holds (21 §4 Resource), keyed in CompiledCartridge.resources by DefinitionRefString of kind resource: inclusive bounds minimum <= start <= maximum (RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID otherwise), start its value on a new body, and gain its regeneration per game hour: each hour boundary the clock crosses (floor(time / 3600) increases) adds gain, stopping at maximum; that stop is the regeneration rule, never a clamp of an adjustment (delta.schema.json resource.adjust). The value is derived, never ticked (02 derived state): it is stored only when written. A body's resources belong to the body, not the character driving it (owner decision on puppeting). Keys hp, ma and mv are the engine's default pools (00 §4 amendment, DikuMUD): the compiler adds them to every loka-cartridge-v2 cartridge, with resource@1 and schedule@1 (whose wait lets an exhausted body regenerate), as hp 0..20 start 20 gain 5, ma 0..100 start 100 gain 4 and mv 0..82 start 82 gain 18, each field overridable in the source's resources.json; mv is the pool a move pays 1 from (movement@1), in a cartridge that declares it, unless the cartridge's world.movement.cost (cartridge.schema.json WorldSettings) names another cost. bands, when present, is this pool's condition band table (BandTable); absent, the pool takes the cartridge's world.bands, else the engine default table (04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02). The compiler writes bands only where the source authors them. resource@1 emits no events. Optional regen replaces hourly gain with exact fractional elapsed settlement using the old stored rate; queries never write. See active mechanics.md resource@1 and protocol.md Composition.

BandTone.description: A condition band's tone (04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02): how serious the band is; each presenter maps it to its own colour.

ConditionBand.description: One row of a condition band table: the band key holds when p, the percentage of the pool's range from its minimum, reaches at_percent (in integers: 100 x (current - minimum) >= at_percent x (maximum - minimum)). key is a content Key whose text is band.<key> in the catalog when the cartridge authors it; tone is how serious it is.

BandTable.description: A condition band table (04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02), highest cut first: the band is the first row whose cut p reaches, and maximum = minimum gives the top row. Cuts are strictly descending and the last is 0, so every value has a band, and keys are unique within the table; the compiler and loader report a table that breaks this as RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID at the table. A pool's bands (ResourceSpec), else the cartridge's world.bands (cartridge.schema.json WorldSettings), else the engine default table.

ResourceRegen.description: Optional exact fractional recovery by stored position rate. Requires position@1, real_elapsed and the recovery API. Compiler/loader additionally require every <= floor(MAX_SAFE/(maximum authored rate+1)).
